title_or_table: American Community Survey 5-year estimates, Table B19013, Median Household Income in the Past 12 Months (in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars)
geography: Every county and county equivalent in the 50 states and DC (3144), Puerto Rico left out, though the Bureau publishes B19013 for its 78 municipios (read November 13, 2026); Connecticut by its nine planning regions; and the United States as the first row (code US)
unit: 2024 dollars, with 90 percent margins of error
qualification: Five years of survey responses pooled, in 2024 dollars; margins are wide in small counties, so read classes with them. Connecticut’s counties are its planning regions, as in the 2024 boundary files.

geoid.description: county FIPS code, state and county; US for the nation

state.description: USPS state code; US for the nation

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, Table B19013, median household income, 2020 to 2024, every county in the 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Survey estimates in 2024 dollars; margins are wide in small counties.
notes: The United States row (RL-1), first in the file: $80,734 with a 90 percent margin of $166, from the same table and release (for=us:1), read November 13, 2026. The same call for every county returned all 3,144 frozen values unchanged. A map sets the nation apart beside it, never as a region.

source_line_variants.with_united_states: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, Table B19013, median household income, 2020 to 2024, every county in the 50 states and DC, and the United States. Retrieved November 12 and 13, 2026. Survey estimates in 2024 dollars; margins are wide in small counties.
